scripts.test: npm run check && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run check && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='.test-build/*.js' --test-coverage-lines=98 --test-coverage-branches=90 --test-coverage-functions=100 tests/*.test.mjs
